inspiration.source_location: Minimized from BUGS/MDEV-36354.sql: INSERT LOW_PRIORITY IGNORE ... SET ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ... RETURNING
inspiration.observed_pattern: A low-priority ignored SET-form upsert returns a conflicting row after assigning column DEFAULT values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one existing inventory row and one RETURNING conflict statement, isolating modifier normalization, assignment-style INSERT parsing, duplicate DEFAULT evaluation, and returned-row projection.

fixture_notes: The existing item must be reset to its declared defaults and returned as item 801; no inserted-row path remains.
determinism_notes: One fixed row and one fixed statement produce a deterministic returned projection; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE inventory_merge_min (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, item_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending')
INSERT INTO inventory_merge_min (item_id, quantity, item_state) VALUES (801, 4, 'queued')

steps.sql: INSERT LOW_PRIORITY IGNORE INTO inventory_merge_min SET item_id = 801, quantity = 9, item_state = 'restocked' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = DEFAULT, item_state = DEFAULT RETURNING item_id, quantity, item_state

checks.sql: SELECT item_id, quantity, item_state FROM inventory_merge_min ORDER BY item_id
